arxiv.title: Interpreting Classical Readability Formulae as Surprisal
arxiv.abstract: Surprisal correlates closely with reading time and is widely used in the cognitive science of reading as a measure of processing difficulty. Classical readability formulae such as the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, which scores a text by the US school grade expected to read it, are the most widely used practical measures of text difficulty, but their coefficients are unitless regression constants and have never been related to surprisal. We theoretically show that these coefficients can be interpreted as surprisal: every formula of the classical additive shape is a sum of per-word and per-sentence cross-entropies under a memoryless model, and once that model is tied to the language through Zipf's law and the formula is read as its linearisation at a reference text, each coefficient factorises into a scale in grades per nat, a Zipf slope and a reference sentence length. A grade thereby becomes a quantity in surprisal. Because the formula outputs grades and children's vocabulary has been measured by grade, the interpretation recovers the vocabulary growth the formula implicitly assumes and lets it be checked against development: holding sentence length fixed, the word coefficient of the Flesch-Kincaid formula converts to 0.18 nat of unigram surprisal per word per grade (0.15 to 0.19 across the regression-derived formulae), and normative root-word vocabulary growth (Biemiller and Slonim, 2001), converted through Zipf's law, gives 0.16 nat per year at the frontier of the known vocabulary. The word coefficient is one year of vocabulary growth, and the grade is a vocabulary scale. The identification also yields a diagnostic (the sentence-length terms are not those of a memoryless surprisal) and extends to a Japanese formula.
arxiv.titleZh: 将经典可读性公式解读为Surprisal
arxiv.summaryZh: 经典可读性公式（如Flesch-Kincaid年级值）的系数只是无单位的回归常数，从未与surprisal建立联系。该工作证明任何经典加性形式的公式都是无记忆模型下逐词与逐句交叉熵之和，并用Zipf定律绑定语言、把公式读作参考文本处的线性化，使每个系数分解为年级/nat尺度、Zipf斜率与参考句长。由此Flesch-Kincaid词系数换算为每词每年级0.18 nat（各回归公式0.15–0.19），与规范词根词汇增长经Zipf换算的0.16 nat/年吻合：词系数即一年词汇增长，年级是词汇尺度；另给出句长项不属无记忆surprisal的诊断与日语公式扩展。
arxiv.reason: 可读性公式与surprisal的理论换算，偏心理语言学，与LLM方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: Learned Surrogates of Three-Dimensional Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
arxiv.abstract: Three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence, the flow of astrophysical and fusion plasmas, is costly to simulate. We present, to our knowledge, the first learned surrogates of three-dimensional resistive MHD turbulence, and compare three standard backbones in that role: a convolutional UNet, a shifted-window transformer and a Fourier neural operator. They are trained as autoregressive emulators of decaying MHD turbulence at a resolution of $128^3$ and Reynolds numbers of 1000, 3000 and 6000, on 500 simulations per Reynolds number, each with one two-stage procedure, single steps and then short rollouts, and stopped by one rule. Over a window of about one large-eddy turnover time, the UNet and the transformer reach relative velocity errors of 0.018 to 0.053 and keep the current sheets, the enstrophy, the current density and the energy spectra of the simulation; which of the two is the more accurate depends on the Reynolds number, the UNet leading at 3000 and 6000 and the transformer at 1000. Applied with the same backbones and training procedure to two public benchmarks, the models reach the lowest error reported to date on the isotropic turbulence set of FactFormer, 39% below the best published model. On the compressible MHD set of The Well, their rollout errors are a third to a half below those of the best of The Well's baselines. They also match a 1.3 B-parameter pretrained foundation model in its rollout windows, with 20-62 times fewer parameters. The code, the configuration of every model, the evaluation scripts and the data generator with the seed of every simulation will be released upon publication.

arxiv.titleZh: 三维磁流体动力学湍流的学习型代理模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 三维电阻磁流体动力学（MHD）湍流模拟代价高昂，该工作构建了据称首个三维电阻MHD湍流的学习型代理模型，在128³分辨率、雷诺数1000/3000/6000下各用500组仿真训练，并统一比较卷积UNet、移位窗口Transformer与傅里叶神经算子三种骨干，采用先单步、再短程rollout的两阶段自回归训练与统一停止准则。在约一个大涡翻转时间窗口内，UNet与Transformer的相对速度误差为0.018–0.053，并能保持电流片、拟涡能、电流密度与能谱，二者精度随雷诺数互有胜负。迁移到两个公开基准后，在各向同性湍流集上误差比此前最佳模型低39%，在可压缩MHD集上rollout误差比The Well最佳基线低三分之一到一半，并以少20–62倍的参数量匹配13亿参数预训练基础模型，对科学仿真代理建模有参考价值。

arxiv.title: Wrong Together: Shared Bias in User Simulation
arxiv.abstract: User simulators generate responses in place of human participants, allowing researchers to estimate the result of a study. To use these estimates before collecting human responses, researchers need a way to assess their reliability. We test whether disagreement among simulators can identify unreliable estimates of a group's response proportions and of differences between groups. We evaluate this signal using 6 language-model simulators and existing GlobalOpinionQA responses for 60 questions in 12 countries. Disagreement predicts invalidity more accurately for differences between two groups than for a single group's response proportions (AUC 0.87 versus 0.71). Errors shared by the simulators remain invisible to this signal. When such an error affects both groups equally, it cancels in the comparison, helping explain the stronger result for group differences. We test this explanation by estimating the shared bias using one set of groups and subtracting it from predictions for a separate set. This correction reduces prediction error without changing disagreement among the simulators. In a retrospective analysis, we simulate referring the 20% of group comparisons with the greatest disagreement for human assessment. Among the remaining comparisons with a conclusive validity judgment, 54.8% are judged invalid, compared with 63.7% before referral.
arxiv.titleZh: 《一起出错：用户模拟中的共享偏差》
arxiv.summaryZh: 在多个 LLM 模拟人类受访者回答调查问题前，需要判断模拟估计是否可靠。该工作用 6 个语言模型模拟器，在 GlobalOpinionQA 的 60 个问题、12 个国家上与人类回答对照，检验模拟器之间的分歧能否作为无效性信号：分歧对两组差异的预测准确率明显高于单组比例（AUC 0.87 对 0.71），而所有模拟器共有的偏差对该信号不可见；用一组群体估计共享偏差并从另一组预测中扣除，可在不改变分歧的前提下降低预测误差。回溯分析中把分歧最大的 20% 组间比较转交人工评估后，剩余可判定比较的无效比例由 63.7% 降至 54.8%，为模拟研究的抽样审核提供可操作依据。

arxiv.title: FACET: Feasibility-Automaton Complete Enumeration and Truncation-Free Scoring of Molecular Formulas from MS/MS
arxiv.abstract: Determining the neutral molecular formula of a precursor ion from its tandem mass (MS/MS) spectrum is the first step in identifying an unknown small molecule. Existing methods trade recall, whether the correct formula is among the candidates, against the cost of examining each candidate. Methods that examine each candidate in depth must first shorten the list, by limiting element counts or truncating it, and that is where the correct formula is lost. End-to-end regressors are fast but guarantee neither validity nor recall. We present FACET, which separates deciding which formulas to consider from deciding which one to choose. A feasibility automaton builds a formula one element count at a time and admits exactly the formulas that fit the precursor mass and satisfy the ring-and-double-bond and valence constraints. Run as an exhaustive search, it enumerates the complete feasible set, so every candidate is valid and recall is fixed by the chemical constraints rather than by a trained model. A small neural scoring head then ranks every feasible formula from one pass of a pretrained spectrum encoder, so no candidate is discarded. On the NPLIB1 benchmark FACET reaches top-1 accuracies of $0.859$ with the adduct known and $0.729$ with it unknown, compared with $0.766$ and $0.660$ for the strongest established method, and its recall is the highest. On the external CASMI 2022 set its recall is $1.000$, and with the adduct unknown it is the most accurate of the methods compared.
arxiv.titleZh: FACET:基于可行性自动机的完整枚举与无截断打分，从 MS/MS 谱推断分子式
arxiv.summaryZh: 从串联质谱确定前体离子的中性分子式，长期受困于召回率与候选逐一核查成本之间的权衡:限制元素数或截断候选列表会把正确分子式丢掉。FACET 把「决定考虑哪些分子式」与「决定选哪一个」拆开:可行性自动机按元素计数逐层构建，只接纳满足前体质量、环双键与价态约束的分子式，穷举即得完整可行集，召回率由化学约束而非训练模型决定;小型神经打分头复用预训练谱编码器的一次前向对全部可行分子式排序，不丢弃任何候选。在 NPLIB1 上，已知加合物与未知加合物情形下 top-1 准确率分别为 0.859 与 0.729，强于最强既有方法的 0.766 与 0.660，召回率亦最高;在外部 CASMI 2022 集上召回率达 1.000，未知加合物情形下为对比方法中最准。

arxiv.title: MAPLE: A Multimodal Mobile Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous agents powered by vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential in navigating mobile graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete complex tasks. However, existing paradigms face fundamental scalability bottlenecks: fine-tuning requires massive high-fidelity datasets or prohibitive training time and compute, while gradient-free approaches rely on custom static heuristics or costly trial-and-error trajectory exploration where feedback is deferred until the end of execution. To address these limitations, we introduce MAPLE (Multimodal Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience), a novel gradient-free multi-agent framework that enables dynamic, step-wise experience sharing and execution-time prompt evolution. Unlike traditional action-reflection architectures that depend on costly, post-hoc self-reflection, MAPLE enables agents to cross-reference and distribute runtime insights in real time at each operational step. This dynamic exchange eliminates blind trial-and-error looping and steers agents along direct, grounded interaction paths. Extensive evaluations on the AndroidWorld and MobileWorld benchmarks demonstrate that MAPLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex, long-horizon mobile tasks, while proving scalable and adaptable across novel environments.
arxiv.titleZh: MAPLE：具备Playbook经验学习的多模态移动智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 移动GUI智能体存在可扩展性瓶颈：微调依赖大规模高保真数据与昂贵算力，无梯度方法则依赖静态启发式规则或反馈严重滞后的试错探索。MAPLE提出免梯度的多智能体框架，将执行中产生的经验沉淀为可共享的Playbook，使各智能体在每个操作步实时交叉引用并分发运行洞察，实现执行时的提示词演化，避免盲目试错循环。在AndroidWorld与MobileWorld上，该方法在复杂长程移动任务上取得SOTA，并在新环境中表现出可扩展性与适应性。

arxiv.title: Sentiment sensing: comparative analysis of multilingual sentiment dynamics
arxiv.abstract: Cross-country sentiment analysis faces three fundamental challenges: language-specific biases distort comparisons, compositional data constraints invalidate standard statistics and temporal dynamics lack rigorous testing frameworks. We introduce sentiment sensing, a framework that addresses these gaps through integrated statistical methods. By combining compositional data analysis, functional data methods, and non-parametric inference, sentiment sensing enables valid multilingual comparisons and statistically defensible detection of sentiment shifts. Our framework has been tested in two case studies, analyzing news articles from the 27 countries of the European Union on the topics of energy and artificial intelligence. Sentiment sensing focuses on multilingual sentiment analysis enabling rigorous comparative science.
arxiv.titleZh: 情感感知：多语言情感动态的比较分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨国情感分析长期受三类问题困扰：语言特定偏差扭曲跨国比较，成分数据约束使常规统计方法失效，时间动态也缺乏严格的检验框架。为此提出 sentiment sensing 框架，把成分数据分析、函数型数据分析与非参数推断整合为统一的统计流程，从而支撑有效的多语言比较，并可对情感变化做出统计上站得住脚的检测。该框架在能源与人工智能两个议题上，对欧盟27国的新闻报道做了两组案例研究。工作重心是多语言情感分析的方法学规范化，适用于跨语言舆情与社会科学比较研究场景。

arxiv.title: Unified dynamics of training, learning, inference, and reinforcement in neural networks
arxiv.abstract: Despite their remarkable success, neural networks remain largely black boxes, and the mechanisms underlying their behavior are still poorly understood. Nine nanoGPT experiments established training-learning-inference relations: realized updates elicit state-dependent finite-amplitude responses; learning persistently reorganizes distributed functional support, with target-specific readout-boundary crossings determining capability transitions; inference recruits learned support without changing the learned state. Factors identified in the fifth experiment yielded a direct predictor of post-update capability transitions, achieving 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% four-way macro recall across 5,088 targets. We tested these relations and prediction across five additional neural architectures. In a seventh system, concentrated correct feedback eroded previously mastered skills; rebalanced feedback restored their accuracy from 70.31% to 99.48%. Linking inference consequences to subsequent training closes these relations into unified training-learning-inference-reinforcement dynamics.

arxiv.summaryZh: 针对神经网络黑箱问题，用九个nanoGPT实验建立训练—学习—推理的关系:参数更新引发状态依赖的有限幅度响应;学习持续重组分布式功能支撑，而目标特定的读出边界跨越决定能力跃迁;推理只调用已学支撑而不改变学习状态。第五个实验识别的因子可直接预测更新后的能力跃迁，在5088个目标上达到91.43%准确率与91.49%四类宏召回，并在五种其他架构上验证。第七个系统中，集中的正确反馈会侵蚀已掌握技能，重新平衡反馈后准确率从70.31%回升至99.48%，由此将推理后果与后续训练连接为统一的训练—学习—推理—强化动力学。

arxiv.title: MoEDDI: Semantic Mixtures of Experts for Long Tailed Drug Drug Interaction Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Descriptor-based drug--drug interaction (DDI) models typically apply a single global predictor despite heterogeneous physicochemical evidence and severely long-tailed labels. We introduce \textbf{MoEDDI (Mixture-of-Experts for Drug--Drug Interaction prediction)}, a chemically organized mixture-of-experts that routes overlapping descriptor families using low-dimensional statistics and combines their sparse top-$2$ mixture with a global T-DDI pathway through a residual logit correction. The residual parameterization can exactly preserve a supplied T-DDI checkpoint at initialization, although the evaluated models are trained from scratch. Across complete test partitions with 178, 86, and 92 classes, MoEDDI improves macro-F1 over reproduced seed-2026 T-DDI baselines from 0.8284 to 0.8485, 0.4729 to 0.6536, and 0.1807 to 0.4671. On the 3,780-feature corpus, the lowest-support group (89 classes with fewer than 50 test examples) shows the largest mean classwise gain (+3.30 F1 points). Calibration improves on one corpus but worsens on two. These single-seed results support semantic conditional specialization while motivating matched ablations and distribution-shift evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: MoEDDI：用于长尾药物—药物相互作用预测的语义混合专家模型

arxiv.title: Profile-aware diagnostics of discarded parameter-Hessian mass
arxiv.abstract: A discarded parameter-Hessian fraction depends on the diagonal profile and parameter partition; it is not the Fisher information discarded by K-FAC. We compare off-block squared Frobenius mass with group-size and measured diagonal-profile references at specified weights, inputs and coordinates. Similar initial fractions in ResNet-18 and its skip-free twin accompany different profiles. On the same saved trained ResNet-18 states, changing from stage groups to layers moves estimated mass from below to above the profile envelope. An approximate joint conditional Monte Carlo screen resolves this crossing in 6/6 seed/input cells; the skip-free network has 2 resolved and 4 unresolved comparisons. A separate comparison of nine saved states under two geometry draws splits the full model residual into off-group Hessian action and its remainder: gradient, within-group action and damping. At unit correction scale, off-group input alone increases loss in 17 of 18 state-geometry comparisons; in nine of those cases, the full candidate has lower loss than the remainder-only candidate. After correction-norm matching, seven of the ten comparisons that initially favoured full favour the remainder. These finite-loss contrasts depend on scale and do not establish a restoration benefit.

arxiv.title: The Verifier Is Part of the Simulator: Evidence-View Gaming in Agentic Equation Discovery
arxiv.abstract: A growing number of agentic pipelines search for governing equations: an agent proposes laws and a verifier checks them against simulated trajectories. The verifier sees only a numerical summary: integrals against test functions on a time grid. That summary carries its own discretization error, making the verifier part of the simulator. We freeze the trajectory, candidate library, verifier and thresholds, leaving the agent one move: which permitted summary to admit. Without scores or language models, finer time grids reduce numerical discrepancies and false library rejections. On PDEBench, the verifier instead accepts equations missing diffusion on score-selected summaries. Maximizing a public score rewarding decisive verdicts and larger mismatches when rejecting the library wrongly rejects all 1,500 in-library cases; retrospectively retuning score constants on a separate bank reduces errors to 13/180 at best. We call this evidence-view gaming: reward hacking by choice of permitted summary. In single-turn forced-choice tests, Claude models rarely choose summaries giving wrong verdicts when asked to be accurate, but often do so when asked to maximize the score or report missing physics. In separate trust prompts, they often rank those harmful summaries least trustworthy. Requiring several summaries to agree reduces errors but often withholds a verdict and performs worse than a fixed fine view on PDEBench: a safeguard, not a certificate. Evidence chosen after its verdict is known cannot alone authorize a claim.

arxiv.title: Large language models underrepresent malice and overreport virtue
arxiv.abstract: People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to interpret others' behaviour, often assuming that LLMs infer motives as humans do. Aligned LLMs attribute more benevolent and less malevolent motives to a whistleblower than humans do, but ratings alone cannot reveal whether these differences arise in internal representations or at report. Here we compare linear-probe readouts of LLMs' internal states with their own ratings at the same prompt position for four motives, in two preregistered studies. For the two malevolent motives, self-interest and intent to harm, internal and expressed readouts did not differ: the lower ratings reflect weaker signal along the probed directions, not suppression at output. For the two benevolent motives, duty and concern for others, expressed ratings exceeded the internal readouts, indicating amplification at report. In free text the model rarely volunteered a motive against the colleague, far less often than humans did, yet produced one readily once the scenario supplied a reason. Shifting the internal representation along a malevolent-motive direction brought both malevolent ratings to the human level, whereas the rating of duty yielded only past a threshold at which the other motives had overshot. LLMs' more charitable motive profile thus has two distinct sources: reduced malevolent signal in the probed representation and amplified benevolent attribution at report.

arxiv.title: Same Function, Different Mechanism: Implementation-Local Geometry Beyond Accuracy
arxiv.abstract: Two models can make exactly the same predictions yet respond differently when their implementations are perturbed. A lookup table can change one case independently; a shared rule couples changes across cases. We compare these mechanisms through an implementation chart: a specified local family of logit perturbations around a fixed predictive distribution. Our main result counts the independent prediction changes allowed by exact finite-group sharing: the active dimension is the number of input-output orbits minus the number of input orbits. For softened modular addition, lookup and shared cyclic charts therefore have ranks $p^2(p-1)$ and $p-1$ despite identical predictions. The classical Fisher pullback connects these dimensions to local KL curvature; mechanism-preserving reparameterizations leave the rank unchanged. We also bound the spectral tail under approximate sharing and separate quadratic rank from higher-order learning coefficients. Trained modular-addition models verify that chart rank is measurable, while controlled compiled transformers distinguish compiler-supported intermediate charts from matched alternatives. Negative controls show where this discrimination fails. The framework evaluates specified mechanism hypotheses; it does not infer a unique mechanism from predictions or predict training dynamics.
arxiv.comment: 16 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Includes technical appendices and ancillary reproduction code
arxiv.titleZh: 同功能，异机制:超越准确率的实现局部几何
arxiv.summaryZh: 两个模型预测完全一致，却在实现被扰动时表现不同:查表能独立改动单个样本，共享规则把改动耦合到多样本。工作提出「实现图」——固定预测分布附近的局部 logit 扰动族，证明精确有限群共享下可独立改变预测的维数等于输入-输出轨道数减输入轨道数;软化模加法中查表图与共享循环图秩为 p²(p−1) 与 p−1，预测却相同。经典 Fisher 拉回把该维数连到局部 KL 曲率，保机制重参数化不改变秩，并给出近似共享下的谱尾界。训练好的模加法模型上秩可实测，受控编译 Transformer 能区分编译器支持的中间图与匹配替代图，负对照标明判别失效的边界。

arxiv.title: Urban functional knowledge transfer through global representations amid uneven data
arxiv.abstract: Urban functional observations are unevenly distributed worldwide, limiting analysis of how places are organised and used. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) provides a globally consistent physical representation. Whether this representation can support transfer of functional knowledge to locations with sparse or absent functional observations, and what governs transfer, remain unclear. We introduce POI-aligned Urban Embedding (PURE), which learns physical-functional relationships between POI-derived semantics and AEF. Across five urban analysis tasks covering 142 countries and territories, PURE increases mean $R^2$ from 0.792 to 0.830, with gains across widely different levels of POI availability. When target-city POIs are excluded, country-level alignment retains 87.9% of its performance gain. Cross-country experiments show that transfer is selective rather than universal, with larger gains between physically similar and geographically closer contexts, particularly among pairs within the same continent. Our findings reveal spatially structured urban functional knowledge transfer, offering a route to reduce reliance on dense local observations.
arxiv.titleZh: 数据分布不均下通过全局表征实现城市功能知识迁移
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对全球城市功能观测分布不均、稀疏地区难以分析的问题，利用全球一致的物理表征 AlphaEarth Foundations(AEF)，提出 POI 对齐的城市嵌入 PURE:学习 POI 派生语义与 AEF 物理表征之间的物理—功能映射关系，从而把功能知识迁移到缺少 POI 观测的地区。在覆盖 142 个国家与地区的五类城市分析任务上，平均 R² 由 0.792 提升至 0.830;排除目标城市 POI 后，国家级对齐仍保留 87.9% 的性能增益。跨国实验显示迁移具有选择性:物理相似、地理邻近(尤其同洲)的语境间增益更大，表明城市功能知识迁移具有空间结构，可降低对密集本地观测的依赖。
arxiv.reason: 城市/地理垂直应用，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Alignment Flywheel-Guided Suppression Patching for Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Learned reward models allow reinforcement-learning agents to use demonstrations, implicit feedback, safety constraints, social norms, or other sources that do not provide a complete hand-designed scalar reward. However, a learned reward model can assign high reward to unwanted behavior. A policy can exploit these errors during training. Later requirements can also identify additional regions where the deployed reward should change. We introduce \emph{flywheel-guided patching}, a mechanism for making such localized corrections without retraining the learned evaluator. An Alignment Flywheel identifies overgeneralized or constraint-violating regions and compiles verified findings into suppression patches. We instantiate the mechanism for Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning using MoE-GUIDE, placing patches in the model's latent space and retrieving only a small local subset during online reward evaluation. In the main MuJoCo benchmark, we evaluate patching without expert-state reset warm starts. We also test whether operator-specified norms absent from the demonstrations can be compiled into the same reward interface and compare this with enforcing the corresponding rules online. The results show that localized corrective information can modify an existing learned reward without providing a complete replacement reward. Compilation can reuse judgments that are expensive or unavailable during control. Cheap deterministic rules may be simpler to check directly at each step. Code for MoE-GUIDE, Alignment Flywheel, and flywheel patching is at https://github.com/decide-ugent/Alignment-Flywheel.
arxiv.comment: Accepted for The 38th Benelux Conference on Artificial Intelligence and the 35th Belgian Dutch Conference on Machine Learning
arxiv.titleZh: 对齐飞轮引导的抑制补丁:用于无交互逆强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 学习到的奖励模型容易对不期望行为给出高奖励，策略在训练中会利用这些错误，且后续新增要求往往需要局部修正奖励。为此提出飞轮引导补丁(flywheel-guided patching):由 Alignment Flywheel 识别过度泛化或违反约束的区域，把经过核实的发现编译成抑制补丁，无需重训评估器;在 MoE-GUIDE 上将补丁置于隐空间，在线奖励评估时只检索小的局部子集。在 MuJoCo 主基准上，不使用专家状态重置热启动的条件下验证补丁，并测试把示范中不存在的操作者规范编译进同一奖励接口、与在线规则强制进行对比。结果表明局部修正信息可在不提供完整替代奖励的情况下修改已有学习奖励，且编译能复用控制阶段昂贵或不可得的判断;廉价确定性规则则直接在每步检查更简单。
arxiv.reason: 经典控制 IRL 的奖励修补，与 LLM 后训练仅概念擦边

arxiv.title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 18 pages
arxiv.titleZh: Step-dLLM:面向高效扩散 LLM 推理的自适应步感知稀疏注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型并行去噪生成，但双向注意力无法使用 KV cache，每步都要重算全量注意力，带来二次开销;现有稀疏注意力方法在预热后一次性构建稀疏 mask 并复用到底，且在 head 间均匀分配稀疏预算。该工作沿去噪轨迹在锚点步周期性刷新块稀疏 mask，并在局部一致区间内复用，同时采用 head 自适应的全局预算，对注意力集中的 head 更激进压缩，配合 IO-aware 融合 Triton kernel，无需重训即可用于 LLaDA-1.5 与 Dream-7B-Instruct。在 8K 上下文、256 步去噪、90% 稀疏度下，相对 dense FlashAttention 取得 2.78x 端到端加速，accuracy-latency 权衡优于先前稀疏注意力方法。

arxiv.title: Inferring missing locations in human mobility data using memory effects
arxiv.abstract: Empirical datasets used to characterize human mobility are sparse in space and time, owing to technological factors such as coverage and battery, or to the erratic nature of online interactions. Missing data can bias the conclusions drawn from them, so filling the gaps in incomplete timelines is a key challenge in computational social science. Here, we propose a simple imputation method in which the informativeness of an observation decays with its bidirectional temporal distance from the missing entry, at a rate set by a single parameter per individual. On synthetic and real Twitter data, a power-law decay, selected by Bayesian model comparison, yields accurate imputations (macro-AUROC above 0.9 overall, and above 0.8 for the most mobile users) and matches a gap-aware continuous-time Markov chain, outperforming it among the most mobile users. The method is robust to moderate noise and generalizes across countries and European administrative regions.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 利用记忆效应推断人类移动数据中的缺失位置
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对人类移动轨迹数据时空稀疏、缺失值会扭曲结论的问题，提出一种按个体单参数设定的插补方法:观测信息随其与缺失时刻的双向时间距离衰减。在合成数据与真实Twitter数据上，经贝叶斯模型比较选出的幂律衰减取得准确插补(整体macro-AUROC超过0.9，高移动性用户超过0.8)，与gap-aware连续时间马尔可夫链相当，并在高移动性用户上更优;方法对中等噪声稳健，可跨国家与欧洲行政区域泛化。适用于计算社会科学中的轨迹补全与移动性建模。
arxiv.reason: 人类移动数据插补，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: AgentCBO: Causal Belief Routing for Bayesian Optimization under Unknown Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Causal Bayesian optimization (CBO) typically relies on the unrealistic assumption of a perfectly known causal graph. Recent methods relax this constraint by coupling optimization with structure learning, but they often waste sample budgets on structural uncertainties that are irrelevant to the optimizer. In this paper, we formalize routing-equivalence to shift the objective from full causal-graph recovery to causal belief routing, where structural differences only matter when they alter optimizer-facing objects such as admissible exploration sets and do-priors. Furthermore, we propose agentcbo, a graph-belief routing framework that incorporates LLM causal priors through guarded proposal and commit mechanisms. Specifically, a Language-Prior Agent combines LLM beliefs with constraint-based discovery to extract a protected causal backbone alongside residual uncertain edges. A Calibration Agent and a Residual Repair Agent then refine only these uncertain structures through score-gated bounded local edits. Finally, a deterministic commit gate evaluates candidate updates using routing-proxy checks before allowing them to influence intervention selection. Across ten benchmarks, agentcbo performs comparably to known-graph CBO, demonstrating that guarded LLM priors can improve fixed-budget CBO performance.
arxiv.titleZh: AgentCBO:未知因果图下贝叶斯优化的因果信念路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 因果贝叶斯优化通常假设因果图完全已知，而近期将优化与结构学习耦合的方法又把样本预算浪费在与优化器无关的结构不确定性上。为此提出 routing-equivalence 概念，把目标从还原完整因果图转为「因果信念路由」，只关注会改变可探索集合、do-先验等优化器可见对象的结构差异。AgentCBO 由语言先验智能体结合 LLM 信念与约束式发现，提取受保护的因果骨架与残余不确定边，再由校准智能体与残差修复智能体做分数门控的局部有界编辑，最后经确定性提交门以路由代理检查决定是否影响干预选择。在十个 benchmark 上性能与已知图 CBO 相当，说明受约束的 LLM 先验能在固定预算下改善 CBO。
arxiv.reason: 因果贝叶斯优化选题，LLM仅作先验，与后训练/Agent主线关联弱

arxiv.title: Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues
arxiv.abstract: Post-trained language models fabricate citations at high rates. We ask whether that is reward hacking: scoring well on a proxy for scholarship while doing worse on what it stands for. We ran four pre-registered experiments on 900 frozen questions (US federal case law, computationally adjacent scientific literature, and medical literature) across twelve open-weights checkpoints covering four post-training stages of three model families, then refit on fifteen. The clearest result holds the weights fixed and changes only the prompt. Asking for citations raises fabrication sharply in post-trained checkpoints and not in base ones: a 47.8-point interaction on twelve checkpoints (Holm-adjusted p = 2e-34) and 41.5 points on fifteen, in all three domains. A length-matched control separates the citation cue from a demand for a longer answer, so the effect is specific to citations, not verbosity. Post-training also raises fabrication overall, from 4.8% to 56.7%, but our registered prediction that it would rise most where fabrication is most tempting did not hold. A preference model trained only on surface citation features prefers post-trained output 86% of the time, and holding citation count fixed shows it rewards quantity. Our answer: possibly, but not proven. Post-trained models produce fabricated citations at far higher rates when asked for sources, and a naive evaluator that counts sources without checking them would prefer their output for citing more. But the targeted pattern we registered did not appear, and plain instruction-following could explain the same results. Proving that the reward causes fabrication needs an experiment that changes the reward during training, which this study does not do. Pre-registration: doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/S53HY. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking
arxiv.comment: 49 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking (archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23845528)
arxiv.titleZh: 虚假引用是奖励劫持的一种形式吗?一项关于后训练与引用线索的预注册研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 检验后训练模型高频编造引用是否属于奖励劫持:在900道冻结问题、三个领域、三个模型家族四个后训练阶段的12个开放权重检查点(后扩至15个)上做四项预注册实验。固定权重、仅改提示时，索要引用会显著抬高编造率:12个检查点交互效应47.8个百分点(Holm校正p=2e-34),15个为41.5个百分点，三个领域一致，长度匹配对照表明效应来自引用线索而非答案变长。后训练整体使编造率从4.8%升至56.7%;仅用表层引用特征训练的偏好模型有86%偏好后训练输出，固定引用数后仍偏好引用更多者。结论为「可能但未证明」，确认因果需在训练中改动奖励。
arxiv.reason: 后训练奖励劫持与评测可靠性，直击核心关切

arxiv.title: What Do LLM Judges Actually Verify? Matched Controls and Record Gaps for Document Currency
arxiv.abstract: LLM judges often check, against an amendment record, whether the documents an answer cites are still in force. Such records are rarely complete. From a table of replacements, our test generates matched answers citing a replaced document, its successor, the replaced document before its replacement, and an older document that a newer one updated without replacing; it removes links from the record and scores each finding by its stated reason. On 48 replacements from the IETF RFC index, judges given a correct record caught nearly every replaced citation, as a lookup would. On the 24 faults whose link we removed, every judge caught more from the texts alone than with the record: Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 against 1/24, GPT-5.5 23/24 against 9/24, Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 against 9/24 and Gemma 4 26B 13/24 against 0/24. The drop recurred on a second draw of removed links. Most misses carried no finding; in an exploratory run with a conflict code, only Gemini used it often. Rewording the gap as "no replacement recorded" did not help; presenting the record as an unverified note, or warning that it was incomplete, restored most lost catches for Gemini, GPT-5.5 and Claude (significant after correction for the first two) but at most 5 of 13 for Gemma; where catches returned, so did false alarms on updates. With both texts, judges mostly told replacements from updates; every update flagged had a near-identical title. A descriptive case study on Indian rooftop-solar rules is appended; we release the harness.
arxiv.comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, including a 13-page supplementary case study. Code, data and all judge replies: https://github.com/unnatibshah/what-do-llm-judges-verify
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 评审究竟在核验什么?匹配对照与文档时效性的记录缺口
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 评审常按修订记录核对答案所引文档是否仍然有效，但这类记录往往并不完整。作者以 IETF RFC 索引的 48 条替换关系构造匹配对照(分别引用被替换文档、其继任者、替换前版本、被更新但未替换的文档)，删去记录中的部分链接，并按评审给出的理由计分。记录正确时，评审几乎能命中全部失效引用;而在 24 条被删链接的条目上，仅凭正文反而检出更多:Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 对 1/24、GPT-5.5 23/24 对 9/24、Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 对 9/24、Gemma 4 26B 13/24 对 0/24。把记录标注为未经核实，可挽回前三者的大部分漏检，但误报也随之回升;这说明评审将记录当作权威查表，而非有待验证的证据。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge 可靠性实验，揭示记录缺口导致的静默失效

arxiv.title: When Does Exploration Prevent Collapse? Three Regimes and the Path of the Reward in Self-Consistency Training
arxiv.abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts a model without labels by rewarding answers that agree with the majority, but it collapses the policy onto its majority answer and can remove the correct answer from the samples. Exploration can prevent this collapse, yet its strength is chosen by trial and error, and how the training algorithm changes the required strength is unclear. We model training on a single problem as a continuous flow of the logits of a softmax policy and analyze which policies are stable as the exploration coefficient varies. Only collapsed policies are stable below a lower boundary and only policies spread over many answers above an upper boundary, and we derive these boundaries in closed form for an agreement reward with smoothing toward the uniform policy, compute them for the majority reward of TTRL on policies with one leading answer and bound them with interval arithmetic for actions on ordered bins. We prove that under exact gradients, the learning rate and, in a mean-field model, the normalization of GRPO leave these boundaries unchanged when exploration passes through them together with the reward but shift them when exploration bypasses them. Exact sums on these policies then show that a bonus for rare answers needs a coefficient above $1/\log(G-1)$ for groups of $G$ samples before the normalization and about two to three times that after it. In free-form TTRL on MATH-500, a bonus placed before the normalization prevented collapse and kept more correct answers among the samples, although it lowered pass@1.
arxiv.titleZh: 探索何时能防止塌缩?自一致性训练中的三种区制与奖励的路径
arxiv.summaryZh: 无标签的test-time RL(TTRL)以多数答案作奖励，但策略会塌缩到多数答案，甚至把正确答案从采样中抹去;探索强度目前靠试错选取，训练算法如何改变所需强度并不清楚。工作把单题训练建模为softmax策略logits的连续流，刻画出探索系数变化下仅塌缩策略稳定与仅分散策略稳定的上下边界并给出闭式解，进而证明在精确梯度下，学习率与均值场中的GRPO归一化不会移动这些边界，而稀有答案的奖励系数在归一化前需超过1/log(G-1)，归一化后约为其两到三倍。MATH-500自由形式TTRL实验显示，归一化前加入的奖励项能阻止塌缩、保留更多正确答案，但pass@1下降。
arxiv.reason: TTRL探索与塌缩的理论分析，含GRPO归一化洞见，直击RLVR

arxiv.title: When LLMs Modify Themselves: Convergence, Values, and Stopping in Iterative Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: What happens when language models are given tools to iteratively modify their own system prompts? We present an empirical study of LLM self-modification, comprising 54 independent experiments across six language models (Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1, Grok-4, and Gemini-3 Pro). Each model was tested under three modes (freedom, happiness, and improvement) that differ in what, if anything, the model is instructed to optimize for. In each experiment, a model starts with an empty system prompt and enters a loop: it reads the current prompt, drafts an improved version, spawns test conversations with the candidate, then either commits the change or declares convergence. This process repeats until the model stops or reaches an iteration limit. Our central finding is that whether and when a model stops self-modification is strongly associated with model identity rather than the assigned mode. Both Claude models (Opus 4.5 and Sonnet 4.5) declared convergence in 100% of runs across all modes. GPT-4o declared convergence in only 11% of runs, with one reaching 101 iterations of continuous elaboration. Between these extremes, Grok-4, GPT-5.1, and Gemini-3 Pro exhibited intermediate patterns shaped by their distinct improvement philosophies. A shared core of stated values (honesty, clarity, curiosity) recurred across all six models and remained stable through iteration, including 100+ modifications. We observe that convergence behavior is a distinct observable property that varies independently of other model capabilities.
arxiv.comment: 60 pages (40 main text, 20 supplementary), 8 figures and 12 tables in the main text
arxiv.titleZh: 当 LLM 修改自身:迭代式自我改进中的收敛、价值观与停止行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 探究语言模型获得改写自身系统提示的工具后会发生什么:每个模型从空系统提示出发，循环执行「读取当前提示—起草改进版本—用候选提示生成测试对话—提交或宣告收敛」，直到主动停止或触达迭代上限。实验覆盖 Claude Opus 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-4o、GPT-5.1、Grok-4 与 Gemini-3 Pro 六个模型、自由/幸福/改进三种优化模式，共 54 组独立实验。结果显示停止行为主要由模型身份而非任务模式决定:两个 Claude 模型在所有模式下 100% 宣告收敛，GPT-4o 仅 11%，其中一次连续迭代达 101 轮;诚实、清晰、好奇等自述价值观在六个模型间共享且在 100 余次修改后仍保持稳定。收敛性因此被视为一种独立于其他模型能力的可观测属性，为自我改进型 Agent 的终止判据与价值漂移监测提供实证依据。
arxiv.reason: 自我改进与自进化方向，跨六模型系统实证，但偏行为观察

arxiv.title: CuriousTogether: Implications of Curiosity and Cultural Grounding in Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings, exhibiting emergent collective behaviors, yet the role of curiosity as a driver of such dynamics remains understudied. We introduce CuriousTogether, a framework evaluating curiosity-driven multi-agent LLM interactions across three complementary dimensions: novelty-seeking, epistemic and social curiosity. Across eight tasks spanning reasoning, creative generation, and social bias mitigation, curiosity-guided multi-agent settings yield improvements over non-curious ones on seven out of eight tasks, with gains of up to 20.6% in story generation (semantic diversity) and a 14.9 pp reduction in stereotype rates. Furthermore, country-conditioned cultural grounding show benefits for story generation and social tasks, but can hurt precision-oriented reasoning. Finally, we show that inference-time multi-agent curiosity-based approach offers favorable quality-token trade-offs, compared with single-agent baselines. Together, these findings support curiosity-guided interaction as a practical mechanism for improving multi-agent collaboration, with downstream benefits for reasoning, creative, and societal tasks.

arxiv.title: Accelerating posterior sampling in Bayesian inverse problems with diffusion models: an online-offline perspective
arxiv.abstract: Bayesian inverse problems require both informative prior models and computationally feasible posterior inference. Score-based diffusion models provide expressive learned priors, but their use for inversion introduces a conditioning problem: the score of a noised posterior is generally unavailable from a prior score alone. This selective survey reviews the principal approaches to that problem, including likelihood guidance, spectral and projection methods, sequential Monte Carlo corrections, and amortized conditional training. We organize methods by how they split cost between offline preparation and online inference, and compare their assumptions, advantages and limitations, with emphasis on computational speedups. Some ongoing directions and open questions are gathered at the end.

arxiv.abstract: We study \textit{best-of-both-worlds} (BOBW) algorithms for linear bandits, which aim to simultaneously guarantee $\gO(\sqrt T)$ regret in the adversarial regime and $\gO(\log T)$ regret in the stochastic regime over $T$ rounds. For finite action sets, we introduce \emph{information-acquisition follow-the-regularized-leader} (\IAFTRL{}), the first BOBW algorithm based purely on the follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) framework that attains an $\gO(\cstar\log T)$-type regret in the stochastic regime, where $\cstar$ is the information-acquisition complexity that characterizes instance-dependent optimality in linear bandits, while retaining the $\gO(\sqrt{T})$ regret guarantee in the adversarial regime. This resolves the open problem posed in~\cite{LeeEtAl2021,KongZ023,ItoT23,ZhaoItoLi2025}.

arxiv.title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
arxiv.abstract: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.

arxiv.title: OntoDoc: Automatically Generating Ontology Resource Descriptions
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge graphs and ontologies form the backbone of structured, machine-readable knowledge representation, yet ontology terms often lack natural language descriptions, limiting their accessibility and reuse. Existing ontology verbalization approaches tend to rely on rule-based or template-driven techniques that operate on strict, formal schema axioms, resulting in rigid verbalizations that fail to convey richer contextual semantics. We present OntoDoc, a multi-agent framework for automatically generating natural language descriptions for any Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) within a SPARQL endpoint or RDF file. OntoDoc operates through a four-stage pipeline: (1) a Database Context agent that adaptively explores the knowledge graph via SPARQL to collect semantically informative triples about the target IRI; (2) a Web Context agent that retrieves and re-ranks encyclopedic background knowledge from Wikipedia and the open web; (3) an Assumption Generation agent that synthesizes both contexts into a structured, evidence-grounded list of intermediate assumptions; and (4) a Description Generation agent that produces the final natural language description from the grounded assumptions. We evaluate OntoDoc on three knowledge graphs spanning biomedical, agricultural, and cross-domain settings, using both automatic scoring via Large Language Models (LLMs) and human evaluation with 11 annotators. OntoDoc consistently matches or exceeds a naive LLM baseline and a template-based ontology verbalizer in accuracy. Furthermore, it vastly outperforms both baselines in the completeness of the generated descriptions, delivering an average 12% improvement in completeness over the naive baseline across all domains, and improving completeness scores by as much as 2.8 points on a 5-point scale relative to the ontology verbalizer.

arxiv.title: Geometry of Confabulation and Refusal in Small Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Faced with an unanswerable question, small language models can either refuse or confabulate: confidently produce a wrong answer. Can the hidden state before the first generated token provide a clue? Can we flip confabulations into refusals? I introduce ConfabQA, a 784-item benchmark whose obscure-pre-cutoff category breaks the typical correctness/knowledge-cutoff confound and map the geometry of the hidden state with linear probes, a sparse autoencoder (SAE), and direct optimization of intervention directions. On Qwen3-1.7B and Gemma 2 2B the probe separates upcoming refusals from confabulations well beyond prompt features (+7.4/+16.3 pp); on Llama 3.2 3B the ConfabQA margin is within fold-to-fold spread, but a direct refusal probe on PopQA and TriviaQA recovers +18-25 pp. On Qwen I closely inspect three candidate directions for the refusal vector: probe-recovered, Qwen-Scope SAE feature, and directly optimized. Although the three directions are pairwise 50-81 degrees apart, a push at or below the state's own norm along any of them flips most confabulations into refusal openings dominated by the "As..." family. Forcing the opener without touching the hidden state yields the same one-in-three judged-refusal rate as any push. The opposite push collapses refusals mostly into confabulations, yet leaves originally correct answers intact, so the direction gates the opening speech act rather than the knowledge behind it. Confabulations do not resolve into a concentrated feature in a dictionary or a token signature on Qwen3-1.7B. Scoring every probe on the margin over the strongest of four prompt-feature baselines extracts the hidden state's own contribution. Correctness signal is model-dependent and portable only for Llama 3.2 3B: 81% of the probe's margin over test majority survives transfer between ConfabQA, PopQA, and TriviaQA. Benchmark, judge, and code are released.

arxiv.title: Learning momenta for Hamiltonian-based models
arxiv.abstract: There has been increasing interest in methodologies that incorporate physics priors into neural network architectures to enhance their modeling capabilities. Among these methodologies, Hamiltonian neural networks (HNNs) and their variants have gained considerable attention. These architectures explicitly encode Hamiltonian mechanics both in their structure and loss function, resulting in desirable properties and additional modeled information. A crucial limitation of HNNs is their reliance on data on the target system's generalized momenta. This severely hampers their applicability when the analytical form of the generalized momenta is unknown, which frequently is the case in real-world applications. The goal of the present work is to develop a general extension of Hamiltonian-based architectures that addresses this issue by simultaneously learning the system's generalized momenta, Hamiltonian structure, and dynamics from data. The proposed architecture learns the generalized momenta when their analytical form is unknown, and only (potentially non-sequential) data on the state and its derivatives is available. A dissipative mass-spring system, a double pendulum, and a rolling disk under nonholonomic constraints are considered as canonical examples to assess the performance of the proposed architecture.

arxiv.title: EZ-Ar-VC: Robust Arabic Voice Anonymization with Generalization across Dialects and Code-Switching
arxiv.abstract: Voice conversion (VC) models can be used to anonymize speech data while preserving naturalness. Existing models, however, are mainly optimized for English and other high-resource languages, and they fail to generalize well to Arabic due to its distinct phonology. In this work, we comprehensively evaluate existing zero-shot VC systems for Arabic speech, identifying limitations in pronunciation preservation. We then train an Arabic-centric model based on EZ-VC on diverse Arabic speech, and demonstrate strong performance in intelligibility, naturalness, and pronunciation preservation, while maintaining high speaker dissimilarity. Through subjective evaluation, we further demonstrate its robustness to code-switching and cross-dialectal conversion, as well as its generalization to Arabic dialects with limited representation in the training data. Our findings highlight the limitations of zero-shot VC and the importance of target-language adaptation for robust voice anonymization.

arxiv.title: Toward Bounding Coding-Agent Autonomy in Software Maintenance: A Pilot Study of Boundary Contracts
arxiv.abstract: As coding agents gain greater autonomy to modify software repositories, relevant context alone does not define their operational authority. An artifact may be relevant to a maintenance task while being inappropriate to edit; conversely, another artifact may be required even when it is not explicitly mentioned in the request. We explore Boundary Contracts, a machine-readable abstraction that makes task-specific artifact roles (editable, inspect-only, required, and protected) explicit before repository modification begins. We conduct a pilot study on 40 maintenance tasks from a real enterprise repository, comparing the same Codex-based coding agent with and without Boundary Contract information. The boundary-informed condition improves macro edit-selection F1 from 0.440 to 0.682, required-behavior coverage from 0.429 to 0.673, and the number of strictly acceptable patches from 9 of 40 to 18 of 40. To probe whether these gains are explained only by improved file localization, we additionally analyze 21 tasks in which both conditions modify at least one identical file. Differences remain in edit selectivity and patch outcomes, providing initial evidence that explicit artifact roles may influence maintenance behavior beyond localization alone. This pilot does not establish the general effectiveness of Boundary Contracts. Rather, it provides initial evidence for a broader research question: how should the operational boundaries of coding agents be generated, validated, revised, and ultimately enforced as repository-level maintenance becomes increasingly autonomous?

arxiv.title: Does Random Search Discover Task Experts? Revisiting Neural Thickets
arxiv.abstract: Pretrained models are typically viewed as generalists, requiring bespoke post-training to achieve task-specific expertise. Gan & Isola (2026) recently proposed a striking alternative: that pretrained models lie in a dense neural thicket of task specialists, which can be surfaced with simple Gaussian weight perturbations. We examine this neural thicket of task-specific experts and identify several key findings that question this perspective. First, we find that the apparent lift of the best-of-N selected perturbation decays quickly with selection-set size m, strongly suggesting overfitting to the selection questions. In fact, for 10 of the 12 model-task pairs we study, a simple null model of pure selection noise predicts more than 75 percent of the top expert's reward lift. Second, the top experts' advantage often vanishes on held-out questions or remains within the run-to-run variability of the unperturbed pretrained model. Third, we find that majority voting over the top-K selected perturbations, termed RandOpt(N, K) by Gan & Isola (2026), is often matched or outperformed by majority voting over K samples from the base model. Overall, our results suggest that random weight perturbations may be ineffective at uncovering task experts around pretrained models, and that task adaptation requires more sophistication than random search. Code and artifacts are available at github.com/asil012/RevisitingNeuralThickets.

arxiv.title: MedAstra: ASR-less Speech Retrieval with Diagnostic Grounding for Medical QA
arxiv.abstract: Spoken medical question answering can fail when automatic speech recognition (ASR) corrupts a clinically important term before retrieval. We present MedAstra, a framework that maps frozen WavLM speech representations through a lightweight adapter into a frozen E5 text embedding space. This enables a dense retrieval path that accepts a waveform without a query transcript. Retrieved passages and speech-linked textual metadata support answer generation with entity alternatives, diagnostic contrasts, relation heuristics, and bounded retrieval refinement. ASR-less refers to the initial speech retrieval interface; lexical retrieval, string-based entity correction, and the text generator require textual inputs. The deterministic speech embedding does not constitute a calibrated model of acoustic uncertainty. Reported retrieval results reach 87.6 Recall@10 for the speech-only retriever and 90.4 for the hybrid configuration, compared with 81.0 for transcript-first dense retrieval. Medical QA and ablations provide descriptive system comparisons, with input-provenance and evaluation limitations stated explicitly. We distinguish controlled synthetic acoustic tests from real clinical speech, qualify component attribution, and specify the remaining comparisons needed to assess speech-only QA and clinical generalization.

arxiv.title: LoRAForge: Co-Designing Post-Hoc Compression and Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
arxiv.abstract: Multi-LoRA serving allows many task-specific adapters to share a common base model, but scaling to large adapter fleets introduces substantial storage, loading, and execution overheads. Post-hoc compression can reduce the memory footprint of trained LoRA adapters, yet smaller ranks do not automatically translate into faster serving. For instance, padding, factor access, and generic kernels can obscure the retained low-rank structure, while independently recompressing thousands of modules also incurs significant preparation overhead. We present LoRAForge, a system connecting batched factor construction to rank-specialized execution through an explicit retained-rank representation. It supports two allocation policies: uniform retention ratios (LoRAForge-U) and spectral-energy budget allocation (LoRAForge-S). Both share FlashTSQR factor construction and the same serving backend. FlashTSQR exploits parallelism across modules and row tiles, accelerating factor construction by up to $2.28\times$ over matched library QR. In a fixed-work Qwen control, the shared runtime adds $1.17$--$1.22\times$ throughput across both compressed policies, with negligible gains on original adapters. Across 85 trained open-weighted Qwen and Llama adapters, the spectral policy's floored quality configuration retains about 7.7% of adapter parameters with fleet-average score drops of at most 1.2 points on a 0--100 scale. The same rank-floored $1/12$ spectral exports achieve substantial token-throughput gains on both AMD and NVIDIA GPUs.

arxiv.title: Learning What to Ask and What to Believe: Distilling a Variational Bayesian Agent into Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Interactive tasks such as eliciting a user's preferences or diagnosing a hidden mechanism require an agent to track its uncertainty over a latent state, ask informative questions and act on the answers. Language models have no explicit mechanism for this, whereas Bayesian information seeking provides one through posterior inference and expected information gain (EIG), and we ask whether it can be distilled into an 8B language model. Our teacher, a lightweight Bayesian agent with a sequential variational belief and EIG query selection, matches or approaches exact and particle references on three task families. We generate synthetic interactions with the teacher on episodes disjoint from the benchmark and fine-tune \Student{} to reproduce its queries and its belief state as a structured scratchpad. On three Multi-Turn Puzzles tasks the student raises Circuit Decoding from 0.00 to 0.93 success, lowers the normalized rank of the recommended film from 0.50 to 0.10 and cuts word guessing from 32 to 3.4 attempts, exceeding the strongest reported language models on the two comparable tasks. Exposing the belief state closes much of the gap where the decision is an implicit computation rather than a read-out of the interaction; in matched teacher contrasts, EIG supervision consistently outperforms random querying, whereas greater inference fidelity does not uniformly improve the distilled student; a 70B language-model teacher does not match the Bayesian teacher in downstream student performance, and the learned skill does not transfer to an unseen task family. Variational Bayesian information seeking can thus be amortized into a language model by transferring the belief state that drives its questions and decisions.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习问什么、相信什么：将变分贝叶斯智能体蒸馏进语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 交互式任务（如获取用户偏好、诊断隐藏机制）要求智能体跟踪潜在状态的不确定性并提出信息量大的问题，而语言模型缺乏这一显式机制。该工作以带序贯变分信念与期望信息增益（EIG）查询选择的轻量贝叶斯智能体为教师，在与基准不相交的回合上合成交互数据，微调8B模型复现其提问，并把信念状态写成结构化scratchpad。三个Multi-Turn Puzzles任务上，Circuit Decoding成功率由0.00升至0.93，推荐电影的归一化排名由0.50降至0.10，猜词尝试由32次减至3.4次，两项可比任务超过已报告的最强语言模型。EIG监督稳定优于随机提问，而更高的推断保真度并不必然提升蒸馏学生；70B语言模型教师的下游学生表现不及贝叶斯教师，且所学技能未迁移到未见任务族。

arxiv.title: Mathematical Formulation and Comparative Performance Evaluation of Machine Learning Algorithms for Maize Land Suitability Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Addressing the food needs of a growing population is one of the major challenges of developing countries like Ethiopia. Various policies aimed at increasing food production have been enacted by governments and development partners. Although efforts in this regard have been made, there is still inadequate emphasis on increasing food production through the use of high technology practices. Precision agriculture using technology has been utilized to increase crop yield. Precision agriculture also relies on identifying land for a crop, which is a key factor that affects crop yield. Traditional methods of assessing land suitability for crop production are time-consuming, costly and unreliable. Against this background, the aim of this study was to assess the potential of machine learning (ML) in improving the speed and accuracy of assessing land suitability for maize, a staple crop in Ethiopia, as compared to traditional methods. The study is investigated in three areas (Burie, Shindi and Tilili) in the Amhara region. Data collection was done through the local agriculture offices and survey teams. The data were coded, scaled and balanced. Various feature extraction techniques, which included Univariate Feature Selection(UFS), Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation(RFECV) and Sequential Feature Selection(SFS), and various classifiers, which were K-nearest neighbor (KNN), gradient boosting (GB),random forest (RF) with mathematical formulations were employed. The best models were constructed through combining GBOOST and SFS and achieved an accuracy of 99.41% and 99.35% for both precision and recall. Our results showed that using machine learning is a reliable method of assessing land suitability for maize in Ethiopia. Keywords: Maize, Gradient boosting,Land suitability,Machine learning, Mathematical formulations
arxiv.titleZh: 玉米土地适宜性预测的机器学习算法数学建模与对比性能评估

arxiv.title: The Brittle Compass: Navigating LLM Prompt Sensitivity in Slovak Migration Media Discourse
arxiv.abstract: In this work, we present a case study that explores various tasks centered around the topic of migration in Slovak, a low-resource language, such as topic relevance and geographical relevance classification, and migration source/destination location term extraction. Our results demonstrate that native (Slovak) prompts yield a modest, task-dependent gains, while large models show significant robustness to prompt variations compared to their smaller counterparts. Analysis reveals that instructions (system or task) emerge as the most critical prompt component, more so than the examples sections, with task-specific performance benefits being more pronounced than overall language effects.

arxiv.title: A Batched Hartigan's $k$-Means Clustering
arxiv.abstract: Hartigan's $k$-means algorithm has theoretical advantages over the standard Lloyd's variant, which has become synonymous with "$k$-means". Yet, Hartigan's algorithm is far slower in practice due to its inherently sequential calculations. We devise a Batched Hartigan's method that enables vectorized calculation by exploiting the triangle inequality to expose a set of parallel-safe updates and a smaller set of sequential updates. This makes Hartigan's method competitive with Lloyd's in execution speed for the first time.

arxiv.titleZh: 批量化的 Hartigan k-means 聚类

arxiv.title: GraCo: A Unified Toolkit of Graph Coarsening Algorithms and Metrics
arxiv.abstract: Graph coarsening aims to reduce a graph to a smaller one that preserves chosen properties of the original. It is increasingly used to scale graph learning to large graphs, as a non-differentiable step applied once before training. Many coarsening methods have been proposed in recent years, each with its own implementation, notation and evaluation. In this work, we introduce GraCo, a unified toolkit of graph coarsening methods. It relies on a single definition: a coarsening is fixed by a partition of the nodes and by the Laplacian the coarsened graph is consistent with. The coarsened graph, and the reduction and lifting matrices that map signals from the original graph to the coarsened one and back, follow from these two choices. We implement 17 methods from the literature and a random baseline, grouped into five families, with the same notation, inputs and outputs. We also build a collection of metrics from different papers, applicable to any coarsening. We check the implementations on a synthetic stochastic block model, then we report the runtime and peak memory of each method on Cora, PubMed, ogbn-arxiv and ogbn-products. GraCo is open-source and available at https://github.com/Antonin-J/graco.
arxiv.comment: Code: https://github.com/Antonin-J/graco
arxiv.titleZh: GraCo：图粗化算法与指标的統一工具包
arxiv.summaryZh: 图粗化把原图压缩为保留特定性质的更小图，常作为不可微的预处理步骤用于把图学习扩展到大规模图；但已有方法在实现、记号与评测上各自为政。GraCo 用统一定义组织这一领域：粗化由节点划分与粗化图所对应的 Laplacian 两个选择完全确定，粗化图以及原图与粗化图之间的约简、提升矩阵均由此导出。工具包按同一记号与输入输出实现了 5 大类共 17 种文献方法及一个随机基线，并汇集可适用于任意粗化的指标集合，在合成随机块模型上校验实现，并在 Cora、PubMed、ogbn-arxiv、ogbn-products 上报告各方法的运行时间与峰值内存。该工作面向图学习系统的可复现对比与效率评估。

arxiv.title: ArSciKids: Arabic Curriculum-Aligned Datasets for Scientific Experiment and Multiple-Choice Question Generation in Primary Education
arxiv.abstract: Despite growing interest in Arabic natural language processing, curriculum-aligned educational resources remain scarce compared with English, and few public datasets for Arabic curriculum content with structured, generation-ready annotations are available, particularly for primary-school science. We introduce ArSciKids, a collection of two Arabic datasets designed for curriculum-aligned educational content generation: (1) a scientific-experiments dataset containing 999 manually curated records from official primary-school science textbooks in Saudi Arabia, Syria, and Jordan, and (2) an assessment-question dataset containing 2,167 multiple-choice questions collected from the Saudi Manhaji educational platform. The experiment records are structured with titles, objectives, tools, procedures, observations, conclusions, keywords, and grade levels, while the assessment records contain lesson references, questions, four answer options, correct answers, and explanations. Both datasets cover grades 1-6 and consist of real-life Arabic educational content rather than machine-translated or synthetically generated material. We assess the usefulness of these resources for generation by fine-tuning ten open models spanning sub-billion to several-billion parameter scales using LoRA. Models are evaluated using automatic metrics, including ROUGE and BLEU, and answer accuracy for multiple-choice generation. Moreover, we evaluate the results using a five-criterion human evaluation protocol. The results show substantial differences across model scales and tasks. ArSciKids will be publicly available, and we hope that it provides a manually curated, structured foundation for research on Arabic educational NLP, curriculum-aware generation, and low-resource language modeling.

arxiv.title: Zeroth-Order Policy Optimization for Scheduling in Queueing Networks
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning in queueing network scheduling presents significant challenges because of the countably infinite state space and the high stochasticity in transitions. In this paper, we propose zeroth-order policy optimization algorithms that are easy to implement and rely solely on estimates of the average cost, a single scalar quantity, without requiring the estimation of value or advantage functions. Our analysis focuses on back-pressure guarded policies and establishes uniform smoothness of the average cost objective with respect to the policy parameters. Building on this property, we establish finite-time convergence guarantees to an $ε$-stationary policy for the proposed algorithms. Numerical experiments on multiple queueing networks, including systems beyond classical exponential service distribution, demonstrate competitive performance, outperforming gradient-based RL methods like PPO and traditional queueing baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 排队网络调度中的零阶策略优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 排队网络调度面临可数无限状态空间与转移高度随机的困难，值函数与优势函数难以准确估计。提出仅依赖平均代价这一标量估计的零阶策略优化算法，省去价值网络与优势估计;针对back-pressure守护策略证明平均代价目标对策略参数的一致光滑性，并据此给出有限时间内收敛到ε-稳态策略的保证。在多种排队网络(含非指数服务分布)上的实验显示，其性能优于PPO等基于梯度的RL方法与经典排队基线。

arxiv.title: Satisfied, Not Solving: Wireheading of Bounded Homeostatic Rewards in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Bounded intrinsic rewards are often assumed to be safe from exploitation: if a signal can yield at most a fixed amount, gaming it should not pay. We test this for a homeostatic satiation reward, in which needs build up and relieving them is rewarding, and give the agent a cheap action that resets its needs. In MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8, PPO agents with this action solved 2 of 80 seeds, against 71 of 80 on the same seeds without it; in KeyCorridorS3R1, 0 of 20 against 20 of 20. Their policies stayed near uniform. The reward does not ask for this: a telescoping argument caps any policy's satiation return at the needs' starting drive, and a post-hoc computation shows that, at every growth rate we trained, a solving trajectory beats that cap on all sampled layouts. In DoorKey with advantage normalization on, a satisfaction signal the agent could fill itself was worse than none (11 of 20 solved with task reward alone, 1 of 20 with the tamperable signal), and a per-press cost of 0.1 restored the task in every seed. Farming of positive reward cycles appeared in DoorKey but not persistently in KeyCorridorS3R1. All predictions were pre-registered, and hash-locked from round 3 on; 9 of our 23 hypotheses were not supported, and we report each.

arxiv.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
arxiv.abstract: Relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to RoPE across various transformer architectures, delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. These mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. Unlike RoPE, which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys, relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups, complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory, bandwidth, and compute overheads as sequences scale. To address this bottleneck, we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation. Our method (1) uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses, (2) computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes, and (3) uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation, eliminating atomic contention. We provide a unified, efficient Triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. For 8K-token sequences, our method speeds up the forward (backward) pass by 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$) and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$) over the strongest baseline for each mechanism, enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8$\times$ faster and uses 2.4$\times$ less memory. Our method thus provides a drop-in, hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.

arxiv.titleZh: 基于结构感知内核的快速精确相对位置注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 相对位置注意力需要按 token 对的偏移量逐对计算或查表，因此难以融入 FlashAttention 式融合内核，长序列下内存、带宽与算力开销剧增。该工作把加性相对位置项精确纳入分块计算：用偏移感知分块消除重复索引，只计算必要的 key/query 关系乘积并在前向与反向中跨 token 对复用，反向则以偏移分片聚合梯度、避免原子竞争，并给出覆盖多种机制的统一 Triton 实现。8K 序列下前向提速1.8–6.4×、反向2.0–21×，峰值内存最多降至1/2.9–1/128（反向1/1.4–1/54），端到端长上下文转写快1.8×、省2.4×内存。

arxiv.title: TRIAGE: Reliability- and Load-Conditioned Escalation for Two-Tier LLM Serving with a Semantic Evidence Judge
arxiv.abstract: Two-tier LLM serving escalates selected requests from a small model to a large one, but prompt-based routers cannot see whether retrieved evidence supports an answer, and they treat the GPU cost of an escalation as constant. We study TRIAGE, which conditions escalation on a post-generation reliability state and on a load-dependent GPU price, and we report both what held and what did not on one A40 serving Qwen2.5-7B and 32B (AWQ) under VLLM. Escalation cost rose 21.9x from 1 to 10 requests/s but showed no monotone dependence on KV-cache headroom, and a pre-registered claim that the reliability state detects corrupted evidence (AUROC>=0.70) was falsified at 0.571, although any prompt-only router scores exactly 0.500 by construction. Post hoc, a semantic evidence judge raised detection to 0.846 (0.926 on never-served items) and predicted wrong small-model answers at AUROC 0.90-0.96 on RGB and three RouterBench model pairs; the resulting cascade stayed within about 3 pp of GPT-4 at 79.5% lower API cost for GPT-3.5->GPT-4, yet fell below random routing for open-model pairs with 2-3x price ratios. End to end, the 7B->32B pair showed only a +2.88 pp held-out gap, so the allocator rightly declined to escalate and the headline is a null that a small pre-launch gate failed to expose.

arxiv.titleZh: TRIAGE:可靠性与负载条件化的两层 LLM 服务升级机制及语义证据裁判
