arxiv.title: Concept-Guided Prompting Strategies Increase Diversity in LLM-Generated Recipe Populations
arxiv.abstract: Novelty in solution generation supports automated discovery, but LLM outputs can remain repetitive. To address this, we propose a simple concept-guided prompting method that generates thematic concepts before responses within each of these concepts. To demonstrate, we generated 1,000 recipes for a recipe book task and compared the results against a human-authored corpus. Two naive prompting strategies were compared as baselines. Concept-guided prompting outperformed both baselines in all cases and reached semantic coverage of 47.0% versus 35.1% and 13.1% in respective prior-title and nonce prompt strategies. These findings suggest broader population exploration and diversity, but remain contained to this specific task. Further work is needed to determine the quality of solutions and generalizability.
arxiv.titleZh: 概念引导的提示策略提升 LLM 生成食谱群体的多样性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 输出容易重复、缺乏新颖性的问题，提出概念引导提示:先让模型生成若干主题概念，再在各自概念下生成候选答案，从而在群体层面扩大探索范围。在食谱书任务上生成 1000 条食谱，并与人类语料及两种朴素提示基线对比，语义覆盖率达 47.0%，而基于先前标题与随机词的两种基线分别为 35.1% 与 13.1%。该方法适用于需要批量产出多样候选的自动发现与创意生成场景，但结论限于该任务，解的质量与可泛化性仍待验证。
arxiv.reason: 多样性提示策略，方向擦边且仅单一任务验证，分量有限

arxiv.title: Lightweight Representation Learning for Low Tucker Rank Tensors
arxiv.abstract: Low Tucker rank tensors provide compact representations of multidimensional dependencies, but standard learning pipelines can incur substantial computational and memory overhead from redundant intermediate quantities. We reduce this overhead without modifying the underlying representation objective or parameterization. Our approach combines three complementary components: (i) sequential extraction of only task-required spectral components, avoiding unnecessary full decompositions; (ii) factor-wise multilinear contractions without materializing large Kronecker operators; and (iii) compact latent-state updates without storing full ambient tensor iterates. These components preserve the algebraic operations and learning trajectories of the original algorithms while reducing their computational and memory footprints. Across five low Tucker rank tensor estimators, our implementations match the original trajectories to numerical precision (relative discrepancies of $10^{-16}$ to $10^{-13}$), while reducing per-iteration runtime by up to $3.12\times$ and resident memory by up to $616\times$ ($99.8\%$) on the main order-3 benchmark at $n=100$, with memory reductions exceeding $900\times$ across the full evaluation suite. These results show that substantial computational redundancy can be eliminated from Tucker representation learning without changing the underlying model or learned representation.
arxiv.comment: 26 pages
arxiv.titleZh: 低 Tucker 秩张量的轻量表示学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对低 Tucker 秩张量表示学习中标准流程因冗余中间量而产生的计算与内存开销，在不改动原有表示目标与参数化的前提下做系统级精简：按需顺序提取任务所需的谱分量，避免完整分解；以逐因子多线性收缩替代显式构造大型 Kronecker 算子；用紧凑潜状态更新代替保存完整环境张量迭代。在五个低 Tucker 秩张量估计器上，实现轨迹与原算法数值一致（相对偏差 10^{-16} 至 10^{-13}），n=100 的三阶主基准单步运行时间最高降低 3.12 倍、常驻内存最高降低 616 倍（99.8%），全套评测内存降幅超过 900 倍。
arxiv.reason: 经典张量分解的数值效率优化，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Capacity Planning for Resource-Constrained Clinical LLM Serving
arxiv.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) under a fixed accelerator budget requires jointly deciding how computational capacity is allocated across model sizes and how incoming requests are routed across that capacity. Although prior work has extensively studied LLM routing and serving efficiency, the relative importance of fleet composition and routing under resource constraints remains less understood. We investigate this question using a controlled four-GPU serving environment with heterogeneous clinical NLP workloads spanning short factual verification, biomedical semantic matching, and long-context clinical summarization. We systematically vary fleet composition, routing policy, and offered load while holding the workload trace and hardware budget fixed. Across 24 configurations, descriptive main-effect shares attribute more variation to fleet composition than to the evaluated routing policies in time to first token, latency, and long-context coverage. All-small fleets provide the best responsiveness and throughput but substantially lower long-context coverage, whereas larger-model capacity improves coverage at the cost of serving efficiency. Heterogeneous fleets provide intermediate operating points but can introduce strong-model bottlenecks when large-model capacity is scarce. In a focused evaluation of this bottleneck, capacity-aware routing reduces mean latency and increases throughput while incurring a small reduction in long-context coverage. Within this measured regime, the results support prioritizing capacity allocation, with routing managing demand within the provisioned capacity.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to the 9th Special Session on Healthcare Data at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: 资源受限场景下临床 LLM 服务的容量规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 在固定加速器预算下，如何联合决定算力在模型规模间的分配，以及请求如何路由，是 LLM 部署的核心问题。该工作用四卡受控环境覆盖短事实核查、生物医学语义匹配与长上下文临床摘要三类异构负载，系统改变 fleet 组成、路由策略与负载，共 24 种配置。主效应分解显示，fleet 组成对首 token 时延、延迟与长上下文覆盖率的影响大于所评估的路由策略:全小模型 fleet 响应与吞吐最佳但长上下文覆盖显著偏低，大模型容量提升覆盖却牺牲效率，异构 fleet 居中且在强模型容量稀缺时出现瓶颈。容量感知路由在该瓶颈下降低平均延迟、提升吞吐，代价是长上下文覆盖率小幅下降。
arxiv.reason: LLM 服务容量规划与路由，属系统效率方向但实验仅四卡

arxiv.title: CivicBench: A Benchmark and Memory Framework for Web-Based Civic Data Analytics
arxiv.abstract: Municipalities publish service requests, geographic boundaries, weather observations, demographic estimates, and operational guidance through independently maintained Web portals. Civic analysis must combine these sources while preserving their schemas, source links, spatial and temporal scopes, and interpretive limits. Tool-using language agents can perform this integration, but existing task benchmarks rarely test whether a computed claim remains supported by the records used. We present CivicBench, a 400-task benchmark over four cities and two years that materializes civic Web data into frozen bundles for reproducible evaluation. Executable contracts score computation, source linkage, coverage, scope, qualified answers, and refusal when the requested conclusion is not supported. We also introduce Task-State Memory (TSM), which compiles tool observations into typed assertions, reconciles records only within compatible scopes, and retrieves a bounded state organized around unresolved constraints. Across nine completed model pairs, eight yield positive mean-score differences with 95\% semantic-contract-cluster bootstrap intervals excluding zero; the ninth interval crosses zero. The benchmark and memory framework make the records behind a claim inspectable at the point of decision.
arxiv.titleZh: CivicBench：面向Web市政数据分析的基准与记忆框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 市政服务请求、地理边界、气象与人口数据分散在各自维护的Web门户中，整合分析时必须保留schema、来源链接、时空范围与解释边界。现有任务基准很少检验计算出的结论是否仍被所用记录支持。CivicBench构建覆盖4座城市、2年时间跨度的400个任务，将市政Web数据固化为冻结数据包以支持可复现评测，并用可执行契约对计算、来源链接、覆盖范围、限定回答及无依据时的拒答打分。配套的Task-State Memory（TSM）把工具观察编译为类型化断言，仅在兼容范围内对齐记录，并围绕未解决约束检索有界状态；在9组模型配对中8组平均分差为正且95% bootstrap区间排除零。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆与可验证评测基准，方向契合但领域偏窄

arxiv.title: GSLM2: Multi-Stream Speech Representation Learning and Generative Spoken Language Modeling
arxiv.abstract: Generative spoken language models (SLMs) offer a route to learning linguistic structure purely from speech, yet they lag far behind text-based models in both capability and data scaling efficiency. We identify two bottlenecks underlying this gap: the limited linguistic quality of existing speech units and the reliance on a single stream of discrete units to represent speech. Multiple codebooks are widely used to encode acoustic features but rarely to represent speech semantics. We present GSLM2, which learns and models complementary properties of speech at multiple levels of abstraction. Its encoder, SpidR 2.0, uses self-supervised learning with differentiable prediction heads to induce high-quality discrete units at multiple levels. A multi-stream SLM then jointly models these units using a shared temporal backbone, stream-specific predictors, and an autoregressive head that captures cross-stream dependencies. Across training data sizes and model scales, up to 6M hours and 6.5B parameters, GSLM2 consistently improves linguistic competence while scaling more efficiently with data. As a result, it substantially narrows the gap between spoken and text-based LMs; across read and conversational speech domains, we shrink the gap by about two orders of magnitude on sWuggy, sBLIMP, and tSC, while also outperforming competitive speech-text systems on all three tasks. We open-source the training code and model checkpoints at https://github.com/facebookresearch/gslm2.

arxiv.titleZh: GSLM2：多流语音表征学习与生成式口语语言建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对生成式口语语言模型在语言能力与数据扩展效率上远落后于文本模型的问题，识别出语音单元语言质量有限、仅用单流离散单元表示语音两个瓶颈。提出GSLM2：编码器SpidR 2.0通过自监督学习与可微预测头，在多个抽象层级上诱导高质量离散单元；多流SLM以共享时间骨干、流特定预测器与自回归头联合建模这些单元，捕捉跨流依赖。训练数据至600万小时、模型至65亿参数下，语言能力持续提升且数据扩展更高效；sWuggy、sBLIMP、tSC上将口语与文本模型差距缩小约两个数量级，并超过竞品语音-文本系统。代码与权重已开源，适用于纯语音无文本监督的语言建模研究。
arxiv.reason: 语音语言建模，多流表征有分量但属语音领域，与LLM后训练主线仅弱相关

arxiv.title: EMG-Hybrid: A Dual-Engine Elite Memory--Guided Adaptive Optimization Framework for High-Dimensional Feature Selection
arxiv.abstract: Feature selection in ultra-high-dimensional, noisy datasets remains a critical challenge due to exponential search space growth, where conventional binary metaheuristics often suffer from premature convergence. To address this, EMG-Hybrid is introduced as a novel three-level hierarchical optimization architecture designed around decoupled operational planes, feedback-driven scheduling, and isolated state refinement. At Level 1, a Dual-Engine Controller monitors population Shannon entropy and empirical fitness velocity, functioning as an architectural master-switch that dynamically routes execution between global exploration and local intensification. This control loop conditions the Level 2 active optimization plane, where an Adaptive Black Hole Gravity (ABHG) execution layer performs aggressive feature manifold pruning via a distance-decoupled penalty kernel driven by fitness similarities and Hamming metrics. To structurally isolate macro-exploration from micro-exploitation, Level 3 encapsulates an autonomous Elite Memory Archive that preserves high-fidelity sub-schemas and hosts a discrete bitwise Differential Evolution (DE) micro-refinement sandbox for resolving complex parameter epistasis. Theoretically, uniform combinatorial bounds derived via Vapnik--Chervonenkis (VC) dimension criteria demonstrate that this multi-level restriction mitigates high-dimensional overfitting. Empirical results across manifolds scaling up to $d > 100{,}000$ features, complemented by high-performance computing (HPC) profiling under lock-free atomic Compare-and-Swap (CAS) primitives, indicate strong performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines. The framework exhibits near-linear parallel speedups, sub-quadratic runtime scaling, and substantial dimensionality reduction, offering a scalable and structurally innovative paradigm for large-scale data mining.
arxiv.titleZh: EMG-Hybrid:一种双引擎精英记忆引导的自适应优化框架，用于高维特征选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向超高维噪声数据中特征选择的指数级搜索空间与早熟收敛问题，提出三级分层优化架构:第一级双引擎控制器以种群香农熵与适应度速度为主开关，在全局探索与局部强化间动态路由;第二级用自适应黑洞引力层，依适应度相似度与 Hamming 距离构建解耦惩罚核做特征流形剪枝;第三级用自治精英记忆档案与按位离散差分进化微调沙盒隔离宏观探索与微观开发。基于 VC 维给出组合上界论证其缓解高维过拟合，在超过 10 万维的数据上取得优于基线的性能，并报告近线性并行加速与亚二次运行时缩放。
arxiv.reason: 经典二值元启发式特征选择，与 LLM 关注方向几乎无交集

arxiv.title: World Models Need Not Be Right to Rank Policies Right: Relative Bounds and Audit Limits
arxiv.abstract: Selecting a reinforcement-learning (RL) policy usually requires additional environment interaction, while learned world models offer cheap but potentially biased evaluations. This raises two distinct questions: can shared model errors preserve pairwise rankings despite poor absolute values, and do they make a small number of real audits more informative? We derive an exact pairwise simulation identity and a relative bound separating common-mode Bellman residuals from policy-specific error. The analysis motivates RAVEL (Relative Auditing of Value Errors in Learned models), a selective policy tournament whose eliminations use held-out real outcomes. We test 45 SAC, TD3, and PPO policies per task in DMC cheetah-run and walker-walk. At rollout horizon 500, model rankings remain strong (Kendall tau = 0.962 and 0.800), and same-run differential-error ratios are 0.674 and 0.106. Yet mean paired audit-error correlations are only 0.007 and 0.090, and pairing changes standard deviation by -2.5 percent and +1.9 percent. Simultaneous intervals attain 99.98 percent and 99.75 percent coverage, but certify only 13.2 percent and 0 percent of decisions at eight audits. RAVEL improves low-budget walker-walk regret, whereas real-only successive halving is better at the largest budget, rejecting the precommitted twofold efficiency target. Frozen-model optimization lowers real return without increasing predicted return on average. Thus ranking fidelity, useful audit covariance, and upward model exploitation are distinct properties, separated in part by closed-loop trajectory divergence.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models in Physical AI
arxiv.titleZh: 世界模型不必正确也能正确排序策略:相对界与审计局限
arxiv.summaryZh: 用学习到的世界模型替代真实环境交互来评估与选择RL策略，关键问题是共享的模型误差能否在绝对值失真的情况下保留策略的两两排序。工作推导出精确的成对仿真恒等式与相对界，把共模Bellman残差与策略特有误差分离，并据此提出RAVEL:一种用留出真实结果做淘汰的选择性策略锦标赛。在DMC cheetah-run与walker-walk上各测45个SAC/TD3/PPO策略，rollout horizon 500时模型排序的Kendall tau达0.962与0.800，但平均成对审计误差相关性仅0.007与0.090,8次审计下同时置信区间虽达99.98%与99.75%覆盖率，却只认证13.2%与0%的决策，且最大预算下纯真实环境的successive halving更优。结论是排序保真、审计协方差与对模型的向上利用是三种彼此独立的性质，部分由闭环轨迹发散所区分。
arxiv.reason: 模型基RL策略评估与审计，属评测方法学但非LLM方向
